## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contract-visible outcome.

## Requirement and issue links

Link relevant issues and `MFX-*` identifiers.

## Implementation details

Describe data-model, runtime, API, storage, or UI changes. Call out any compatibility or migration behavior.

## Validation

List tests, fixtures, browser checks, or manual verification performed.

## Accessibility, security, and operations

Describe keyboard/focus behavior, access-control effect, data handling, logging/monitoring, and deployment impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation and examples were updated where needed.
- [ ] Tests cover normal and error behavior.
- [ ] Public format/API changes include versioning or migration notes.
- [ ] No secrets, access codes, personal data, or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] I followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
